svg.title: Four deck formats: teaser, send-ahead deck, live pitch and data room
svg.desc: Teaser: 5–7 slides for a cold email, reads alone. Send-ahead deck: up to 20 slides, a 12–16 slide core plus an appendix, sent before the first meeting, proof in the first three slides. Live pitch: 8–10 slides that you present, big type, Kawasaki 10/20/30 rule from 2005. Data room: no slide limit, for due diligence, with a separate link per firm.
svg.text: One story, four formats. Most founders need the send-ahead deck first.
Working ranges we use. Papermark 2026: sweet spot 9–16 pages, 12 pages get the most views.
